column1: # Inline suppressions that the language makes necessary. Read by scripts/check-suppressions.sh.
# Format: path<TAB>line without indentation<TAB>reason. Each entry covers 1 line; an entry with no matching line fails the check.

column3: recordInterceptor: Field.get returns Object and Spring Kafka 3.x has no getter, so the cast to RecordInterceptor<K, V> is an unchecked conversion that Java cannot check at run time (JLS 5.1.9, 5.5)
proxy: Proxy.newProxyInstance returns Object, so the cast to Producer<K, V> is an unchecked conversion that Java cannot check at run time (JLS 5.1.9, 5.5)
invoke: InvocationHandler.invoke receives arguments as Object, so the cast to ProducerRecord<K, V> is an unchecked conversion that Java cannot check at run time (JLS 5.1.9, 5.5)
